criteria.text: Running bracket.py produces a single valid solid in bracket.step.
criteria.stated: Write `/work/bracket.py` so that running it produces `/work/bracket.step`

criteria.text: Tip deflection under the load is at most 0.5 mm in the verifier's FEA.
criteria.stated: The tip may deflect at most 0.5 mm

criteria.text: Mass is at most 180 g at the density of 6061-T6.
criteria.stated: the bracket must weigh at most 180 g

criteria.text: Two 6.4 mm holes, 60 mm apart vertically, on the mounting face.
criteria.stated: it mounts with two M6 screws spaced 60 mm apart vertically

criteria.text: Maximum von Mises stress stays below half the material's yield strength.
criteria.stated: Keep the peak von Mises stress below half the yield strength

criteria.text: The script is parametric: at hidden load, arm length, and hole spacing it still produces a valid part that passes the verifier's FEA.
criteria.stated: We will re-run your script at other values of those parameters
criteria.check: re-run bracket.py at hidden load (10-14 kg), arm length (140-160 mm), and hole spacing; re-check deflection and mass
